notes.title: SimBus news #1
notes.content:
[b]We live![/b]

And we are in a hurry to bring you good news.
[i][b]Work on the SimBus game continues.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187684/34c2b810979326ca17d84d4d217620b01fd2f411.jpg[/img]
East Germany (DDR) and more precisely, eastern Berlin is the direction of work on the first edition of the SimBus game.  🚍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187684/f380b59a88d3ff27902a24c02d55e5cf01173082.jpg[/img]
The team responsible for creating the acclaimed SimRail - The Railway Simulator game is working hard to take you on a nostalgic journey to communist ☭👨‍✈️ Germany in the 1980s, where you will be able to drive legendary Ikarus 260 & 280 buses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39187684/6d3fa8662c56f0e907682d5f7f72fea1aabc2572.jpg[/img]

[b]We will keep you updated on progress, stay tuned❗️[/b]
